headline: Maurits, it is strike day, but lines L and U run normally.

acts.text: Showers and gusty wind around 11°C. Lines L and U run normally; RER D and lines J, N, R and P run two trains in three.
From 11 AM, 17 metro and RER stations close around Étoile, Concorde, Invalides and Austerlitz; the march leaves Nation at 2 PM for Place d'Italie.
Showers continue under a yellow wind warning. Line U's last train from La Défense is 9:15 PM, and the A13 tunnel stays shut outbound.

weather_line: Saint-Cloud and Issy: showers from morning to night after heavy overnight rain, 11°C to 16°C, about 24 mm, yellow wind warning

items.title: General strike: your lines run, central Paris does not
items.text: Transilien forecasts normal service on lines L and U, and RER A, B, C and E run normally. From 11 AM, 17 stations close; the march leaves Nation at 2 PM for Place d'Italie.
items.link_phrase: forecasts normal service on lines L and U

items.title: A13 Saint-Cloud tunnel, day two
items.text: The outbound tube stays closed until August 2027; inbound is open and the A14 is toll-free on weekdays for cars.

items.title: GHR hotel and restaurant congress at Paris Bercy
items.text: The national GHR 2026 congress for hoteliers and restaurateurs opens today in Bercy. Also on the agenda: Iliad Q3 results at 8 AM.

items.title: Amadeus breach list keeps growing
items.text: Caribbean Airlines joined Singapore, Cathay, ANA, JAL, Korean, Malaysia and Condor among carriers whose booking data was exposed via an Amadeus display system. Qantas is investigating.
items.link_phrase: booking data was exposed via an Amadeus display system

items.title: Airbnb pushes into hotels
items.text: Airbnb is adding hotels to take on Expedia and Booking.com, and says AI already handles about 40% of its customer service.
items.link_phrase: adding hotels to take on Expedia and Booking.com

items.title: Expedia raises its bookings outlook
items.text: After a Q3 beat, Expedia lifted full-year booking growth to about 10%, citing B2B growth and AI efficiencies.
items.link_phrase: lifted full-year booking growth to about 10%

items.title: What today's strike may cost
items.text: Estimates put the cost of today's six-union strike at 300 million to 1 billion euros, four weeks before the Christmas retail peak.
